requirement_text.REQ-152: Deny all four ambient Lua time sources (os.time, os.date, os.clock, os.difftime) and implement platform.now() (LUA-14 restated). See docs/requirements.yaml REQ-152 for full text and its 8-item acceptance_criteria list -- read that file directly for the complete test-level criteria.

task.description: TEST-DESIGNER (WF-02 Step 3) for REQ-152. Real application-executable surface exists (sandbox.ex, platform.ex) -- full procedure applies, scope test is a formality here.
acceptance_criteria: Write test/specs/REQ-152.md and test code covering every one of REQ-152's acceptance_criteria in docs/requirements.yaml: os.time/date/clock/difftime nil-or-raise from inside a script; default denials still hold (os.execute, load nil-or-raise); remaining 7 os functions nil-or-raise (all 11 total proven unreachable); platform.now() parseable by DateTime.from_iso8601/1; injectable exact-timestamp test via TimeSource swap; moduledoc content assertions if applicable; mix test/compile pass
Every acceptance criterion has >=1 test case that would fail if violated
No test depends on wall-clock time or unseeded randomness -- use the injectable TimeSource for the exact-timestamp test
Follow existing test conventions in test/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox_test.exs

result.summary: Wrote test/specs/REQ-152.md (criterion-by-criterion rationale for all 8 acceptance criteria) and test code covering every criterion. Extended test/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox_test.exs with: 4 tests for os.time/date/clock/difftime raising from inside a script (AC1); 2 trap-guard regression tests re-asserting os.execute/load still denied via Sandbox.new/0 and Sandbox.new/1 with arbitrary opts against the 33-entry list (AC2); 7 tests for the remaining os functions (os.exit, os.getenv, os.remove, os.rename, os.setlocale, os.tmpname, os.execute) completing all 11 os functions (AC3); 4 moduledoc content assertions on Sandbox for the 6-of-11 finding, BEYOND-LUA-14 framing, 28->33 count, and os.setlocale gap-closure disclosure (AC6). Created new test/letflow/engine/lua/platform_test.exs with: 2 tests for platform.now() parseable by DateTime.from_iso8601/1 (script-visible and direct Elixir call) (AC4); 3 tests for exact pre-set timestamp injection via a local FixedTimeSource behaviour swapped in via Application.put_env/on_exit, including a live-resolution proof (AC5); 5 moduledoc content assertions on Platform for the ungated-by-design statement, REQ-157 symmetry warning, and injection-mechanism/composition-point disclosure (AC7). AC8 (mix test/compile output) is TEST-RUNNER's Step 4 responsibility per project convention (same disposition as REQ-151's spec). No test depends on wall-clock time or unseeded randomness -- all exact-value assertions use a hardcoded DateTime literal via the injectable TimeSource; parseability-only assertions never assert a specific value. Did not run mix test/compile myself, per instructions.
